studioPage.metaDescription: Meet Stephany Seijas, architect and 3D designer and founder of Nina Marquina: architecture, renovations, construction and interior design in El Hatillo, Caracas and Punta Cana.
studioPage.label: The studio
studioPage.title: Stephany Seijas
paragraphs: I'm Stephany Seijas, an architect and 3D designer, and I'm the person behind Nina Marquina. I specialise in developing and visualizing architecture and interior design projects, working from El Hatillo for clients in Caracas and Punta Cana.
My approach is about turning my clients' ideas into integrated, functional designs, creating spaces where experience becomes the main element.

From the first conceptual sketches and space planning to technical drawings, high-quality renders and support on site, I work through a structured, coherent process. Ideas evolve clearly and intentionally, with a real connection between design, function and atmosphere.

By combining architectural thinking with advanced 3D visualization, I help clients understand, refine and experience their projects before they are built. Every space is conceived not only to be seen, but to be lived in.
